subject.why: Clearly depicts the requested Gothic clock tower with the magnifying glass weathervane.

category.why: Low-angle heroic view grounded firmly on a riverside lawn with a simple backdrop.

clean.why: Clean image free of text, numbers, UI elements, or characters.

framing.why: Centred subject with ample breathing room on top and sides, correctly anchored at the base.

colour.why: Warm, juicy sunset palette with bright lighting and clear subject separation.

detail.why: Appropriately stylized chunky shapes with no distracting micro-textures or busy clutter.

style.why: Matches the reference style with smooth volumes, soft bevels, and satin sheen.
